candidate.title: MARS-Seq
candidate.scope: The single MARS-Seq row of the assigned Illumina poster: poly(A) RNA through a UMI/T7-associated transcriptional amplification intermediate to an adapter-bearing P5/P7 cDNA library. The matching collection page is headed MARS-Seq and captions its matching row as a schematic overview of MARS-Seq. Adjacent Digital RNA/HiRes-Seq/FREQ-Seq/RNAtag-Seq and Quartz-Seq rows, and the chemical panel at right, are context rather than alternative target workflows. This is a schematic-level extraction, not a complete protocol; FACS, pooling and three-level barcoding reported by the paper explain sample identity without adding unshown workflow branches.

states.label: Purified amplified cDNA library bearing P5 and P7
features: Final sequenced carrier is cDNA, not the original mRNA or amplified RNA.
P5 and P7 are explicitly labelled at opposite ends.
Primary MARS-Seq uses molecular, cellular and plate-level tags for molecule counting and multiplexing; the small schematic explicitly labels only UMI/T7 upstream and P5/P7 downstream.
Oligo(dT)-initiated representation is of polyadenylated RNA; the supplied catalogue reports 3-prime bias.
The primary paper describes the resulting transcriptional profiles as samples of each cell’s mRNA pool; library production alone does not establish recovery of every original mRNA molecule.

checks.rationale: Independent inspection supports this schematic-level extraction. The candidate retains every MARS-Seq transformation from poly(A) RNA to P5/P7 cDNA, separates neighbouring workflows, and follows RNA, cDNA, amplified RNA, adapter-linked RNA and final DNA consistently. No extra compartment, pooling event, unshown alternative, independent processed branch, or universal fragment-tag retention is asserted. Every listed reference is assessed with its available evidence level.
